frontier_selector.why: The evidence of a homogeneous, well-defined nodule with increased FDG uptake and the patient's asymptomatic status, despite being a point against Sarcoidosis, is outweighed by the lack of strong evidence against it compared to other options.

support_spans: a 20-mm homogeneous, well-defined nodule in the right paratracheal region
FDG-PET showed increased uptake in this lesion (maximum SUV, 5.3)
a repeat CT 3 months later showed no change in the nodule’s size
contradict_spans: a preliminary diagnosis of malignant lymphoma or metastatic lymph node
